name: hermes-agent
description: The agent that grows with you
one_liner: A personal AI assistant you can run yourself, with both a desktop app and a chat-style interface, that can be extended with new abilities over time.
buyer: A small business owner or solo professional who wants a private, customizable AI assistant without depending on a big-tech chatbot subscription.
business_use_cases: A boutique consultancy deploys it as a branded internal assistant for research and drafting, without sending data to a third-party chatbot.
An indie developer builds and sells a niche vertical assistant (e.g. for real-estate agents) on top of its extensible agent framework.
A privacy-focused startup offers it as the backbone of a 'your data never leaves your servers' AI product.

money_ideas.idea: White-label it into a industry-specific assistant (legal intake, real estate, insurance) and sell as a hosted subscription.
Offer paid setup and customization services for businesses that want it self-hosted but can't configure it themselves.

steal_this: This weekend, fork it into a single-purpose branded assistant for one niche (e.g. 'AI assistant for wedding photographers') and demo it to five potential customers.
